The '''''Valiant''''' class was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that saw service within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In about [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the ''Valiant'' was dispatched to the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous system]] accompanied by another cruiser and a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], where the three [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] ambushed the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] near to the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Circarpous Major]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Corsa]]&mdash;an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who served aboard the ''Valiant''&mdash;hailed the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and ordered the ship to stand down and prepare to be boarded. However, the ''Falcon'' took evasive action and successfully avoided capture by the Imperials.
